chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) say regarding marriage: 'From the Sunnah is marriage at night, because Allah made the night for rest, and the women are indeed a tranquility.'
ai.seo_question: Why is it recommended to perform marriage ceremonies at night in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of al-Washsha, establishes the night as the preferred time for marriage ceremonies to foster intimacy, grounded in the Quranic concept of spouses as 'garments' and sources of tranquility. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on aligning ritual practices with the natural rhythms of rest and emotional bonding prescribed by divine wisdom.
